facts.text: Dromoland Castle is a 16th-century castle in the heart of County Clare on the west coast of Ireland.
facts.excerpt: Located in the heart of County Clare on the west coast of Ireland, the 16th century Dromoland Castle

facts.text: The castle is surrounded by five hundred acres of parklands and woodlands.
facts.excerpt: Surrounded by five hundred acres of unspoiled parklands and woodlands

facts.text: The castle's lineage dates back to Brian Boru, one of Ireland's last High Kings.
facts.excerpt: back to one of Ireland’s last High Kings – Brian Ború

facts.text: Guests can meet an owl and walk through the forest with a hawk on their wrist.
facts.excerpt: Trade secrets with a friendly owl and learn about the wonders of Ireland’s native creatures. Wander through the ancient forest with a hawk on your wrist

facts.text: Estate activities include rowing, fishing, clay pigeon shooting and archery.
facts.excerpt: Row a boat. Catch a fish. Try your hand at clay pigeon shooting or chance your arm at archery.

facts.text: Guests can tour the castle halls with a storyteller who shares tales of Dromoland's history.
facts.excerpt: Roam the Castle halls with a gifted storyteller by your side, hearing tales of the noblemen and wildmen and strong-willed women who left their marks on Dromoland through the centuries.
